wallet.title: Wallet
wallet.balanceHint: Cash in the shared wallet right now.
wallet.negative: The wallet is below zero: more has been paid out than it held. If a partner put money in, record it as a contribution.
wallet.advancesHint: Paid to instructors ahead of their workshops.
wallet.owedHint: Fees of closed workshops not paid yet.
wallet.openHint: Result of workshops not closed yet, after their instructor fees, minus general expenses.

empty.title: Nothing recorded yet
empty.description: Start with a capital contribution: the money the partners put into the wallet.

toClose.title: Ready to close
toClose.description: Workshops that are over or cancelled.
toClose.none: No workshop is waiting to be closed.

instructors.title: With instructors
instructors.description: Advances out and fees still to pay.

capital.remainingHint: Capital less the business's own costs
capital.workshopsHint: Workshop income less materials and instructor fees
capital.otherHint: Money held by instructors, or fees and refunds not paid yet

forms.noteHint: Optional. Anything that will help you remember it later.
forms.advanceHint: Choose the advance if the instructor bought this with the advance money.
forms.categoryHint: A few words, for example: venue, materials, catering.
forms.toWallet: Goes back into the shared wallet.
forms.itemHint: For example "wooden work table" or "pottery kiln".

contribution.title: Add a capital contribution
contribution.description: Both partners always put in the same amount. Enter one partner's part; it is recorded for each of them.

withdrawal.title: Record a withdrawal
withdrawal.description: Money a partner takes out of the shared wallet.

workshop.title: Add a workshop expense
workshop.description: Something this workshop needed, like the venue, materials or catering.

general.title: Add a general expense
general.description: An expense not tied to one workshop, like the website or accounting.

furnishing.title: Add a furnishing expense
furnishing.description: Furniture and equipment bought for the studio, like a table, chairs or tools. Upload a photo of the item and its receipt separately.

pick.title: Add a workshop expense
pick.description: Choose the workshop and record its expense with the details and receipt. It comes off that workshop's income.

paid.title: Record an advance paid
paid.description: Money paid to the instructor before the workshop. It is set off against their fee when the workshop is closed.

returned.title: Record a returned advance
returned.description: Money the instructor paid back. They hold {amount} now.

pay.title: Pay the instructor
pay.description: {name} is still owed {amount} for this workshop.

reverse.title: Reverse this entry?
reverse.description: “{what}” stays in the history, and a correction entry cancels its amounts. Use this for mistakes, then record the right entry again.

partners.title: Partners
partners.description: Each partner's capital account, step by step. Profit shares are fixed and equal (Settings → Money).

sharesWarning.title: The shares don’t add up to 100%.
sharesWarning.description: Until this is fixed, no workshop can be closed.

empty.title: No partners yet
empty.description: The partners are the site's super admins.

card.contributionsHint: Money put into the shared wallet
card.withdrawalsHint: Money taken out of the shared wallet
card.profitSharesHint: Profit or loss of the workshops whose books are closed
card.openShareHint: Workshops not closed yet and general expenses
card.equityHint: Capital now plus the share of the open result
card.noWorkshops: No workshop has been closed yet. When one is closed, the profit share shows up here by itself.
card.moreWorkshops: and {count} more in the full statement
card.owedHintClosed: Profit not taken out yet. While withdrawals are closed, it stays in the shared wallet.
card.owedHintOpen: Profit not taken out yet, held in the shared wallet.

partners.partnerGone: One of these people is no longer an active admin. Please reload the page.

ledger.title: Transactions
ledger.description: Every movement of money, in double entry. Nothing is ever edited or deleted: mistakes are reversed.
ledger.details: Show the debit and credit lines
ledger.registrationEntry: A registration’s payment or refund isn’t reversed here. To undo a payment, cancel the registration: the refund it is owed then appears in Refunds.
ledger.noResultsHint: Try other dates, a different search, or clear the filters.

empty.title: No transactions yet
empty.description: Contributions, expenses and workshop payments will appear here as you record them.

reports.title: Reports
reports.description: Profit and loss by period, workshop and instructor, and each partner’s statement.
reports.pnlNote: Entries count on the day they happened, and an instructor’s fee on the day its workshop is closed, so workshops not closed yet appear without their fee. The closing entry, which only passes a workshop’s result to the partners, is left out.
reports.estimatedNote: * Estimated: the fee a confirmed workshop will owe its instructor under the contract. It is booked when the workshop is closed.
reports.partnerNote: Positive amounts add to the partner’s capital; negative ones (withdrawals, a share of a loss) reduce it.

empty.title: Nothing in these dates
empty.description: Choose other dates to see the figures.

finances.registrationsPaid: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody has paid yet} other {# paid}}{pending, plural, =0 {} other {, # not paid yet}}
finances.finalNumber: Final number at the go decision: {count}
finances.revenueInBooks: {amount} of it is in the books so far.

fee.cancelled: No fee: the workshop was cancelled.

finances.expensesCount: {count, plural, =0 {No expenses yet.} one {# expense} other {# expenses}}
finances.projectedHint: If the workshop closed with these figures.

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.description: Everything this workshop cost, and who paid for it.

advance.title: Instructor advance
advance.description: Paid before the workshop and set off against the fee at closing. Whatever is left must come back, or be recorded as an expense paid from it.

split.title: Each partner’s share
split.description: Of the expected net profit, by today’s shares.

settlement.title: Settlement with {name}
settlement.toPay: Pay the instructor when you can, then record it here.

closed.title: Closed on {date}.
closed.description: These figures are final and can’t change any more.
closed.participants: {count, plural, =0 {No participants} one {# participant} other {# participants}}

errors.workshopGone: We couldn’t find this workshop. It may have been removed.
errors.workshopClosed: This workshop is already closed, so its figures can’t change any more.
errors.partnerGone: We couldn’t find this partner. Please reload the page and try again.
errors.partnerInactive: This person is no longer an active partner. Please choose someone else.
errors.moreThanAdvance: That is more than the advance the instructor still holds.
errors.advanceNotNow: An advance can only be paid for a workshop that is still going ahead.
errors.moreThanOwed: That is more than the instructor is still owed for this workshop.
errors.nothingToPay: This registration has nothing to pay.
errors.moreThanPaid: That is more than was paid for this registration and not yet refunded.
errors.registrationGone: We couldn’t find this registration. It may have been removed.
errors.entryGone: We couldn’t find this entry. Please reload the page.
errors.cannotReverseReversal: This entry is itself a correction, so it can’t be reversed. If needed, record the original again.
errors.closingIsFinal: Closing entries are final and can’t be reversed.
errors.alreadyReversed: This entry has already been reversed.
errors.reverseLaterFirst: Later entries depend on this one. Please reverse those first.
errors.registrationEntry: A registration’s payment or refund can’t be reversed. To undo a payment, cancel the registration in the workshop’s registrations: the refund it is owed then appears in Refunds.
errors.withdrawalsClosed: Taking money out of the shared wallet is closed for now (Settings → Money).
errors.noSpender: No partner has been chosen yet to pay costs from the shared wallet. Choose one in Settings → Money.
errors.notSpender: Only {name} can pay and record costs from the shared wallet.
errors.fileGone: One of the files could not be found. Please upload it again.

validation.amountPositive: Please enter an amount above zero.
validation.amountTooBig: This amount is too large. Please check it.
validation.notInFuture: The date can’t be in the future.

close.panelDescription: Closing locks the figures, sets off the advance against the fee and shares the result between the partners.
close.title: Close “{title}”?
close.description: These are the final figures. Once closed, they are locked and can’t be changed.
close.instructorWithAdvance: The instructor’s advance of {advance} is set off against the fee. Still to pay them: {owed}.
close.done: Workshop closed. The figures are locked.
close.changed: The figures changed while you were looking. Please check the new figures and close again.

issues.notClosable: A workshop can be closed once it is confirmed and has taken place, or when it is cancelled.
issues.notEnded: The workshop hasn’t finished yet. You can close it after it ends.
issues.noContract: This workshop has no valid contract, so the instructor’s fee is unknown.
issues.refundsOwed: Some refunds of this workshop haven’t been paid back yet. Pay back the refunds first and mark them as refunded; then you can close it.
issues.unpaidRegistrations: {count, plural, one {# registration is still not paid. Record the payment, or cancel the registration if the person didn’t come;} other {# registrations are still not paid. Record each payment, or cancel the registration of anyone who didn’t come;}} then you can close it.
issues.revenueMismatch: Some payments or refunds of this workshop aren’t in the books yet.
issues.advanceTooBig: The instructor still holds more advance than their fee. Record what they returned, or what they spent on the workshop, first.
issues.sharesNot100: The partners’ shares don’t add up to 100%.

refunds.title: Refunds
refunds.description: Money to pay back by hand. Once you’ve paid it back, mark it here: it’s booked in the wallet and the person gets an email.
refunds.search: Search by name, email or phone

mark.title: Paid {amount} back?
mark.description: To {name}, for “{title}”. It’s booked in the wallet, and they get an email saying it’s on its way.
mark.method: How did you pay it back?
mark.done: Marked as refunded. {name} gets an email.

change.title: Change the refund for {participant}
change.description: {paid} was paid, and {refund} is to go back now. If the date, venue or instructor changed, the terms promise a full refund.
change.hint: Up to {amount}, what was paid. 0 means no refund.
change.after: It waits in Refunds until you mark it as paid back. When there’s a refund, {name} gets an email with the new amount.

empty.title: No refunds to pay back
empty.description: When someone who paid cancels, or a workshop is cancelled, the refund shows up here.

errors.alreadyRefunded: This refund is already marked as paid back. Nothing more to do.
errors.nothingOwed: Nothing is owed back on this registration.
errors.chooseMethod: Please choose how you paid it back.
errors.beforePayment: The refund date can’t be before the day they paid.

rules.noSpender: No partner has been chosen yet to pay costs from the shared wallet. Choose one in Settings → Money.
rules.onlySpender: Costs are paid from the shared wallet by {name}; they record this.

receipts.title: Receipts
receipts.description: Every receipt, invoice and photo kept with an expense.

empty.title: No receipts yet
empty.description: When you add a photo or PDF of the receipt while recording an expense or a furnishing expense, it shows up here.

field.receiptsHint: A photo or PDF of the receipt. You can add several files.
field.photosHint: A photo of what was bought.
